evidence: Tier 1 (executed differential, oracle-generated): the unmodified product-sdk libOpenMS (Debug, core 4fdec46; git diff 4fdec46..bc9cc12 empty for FAIMSHelper.{h,cpp}, FAIMSHelper_test.cpp, IM_FAIMS_test.mzML, MzMLHandler.cpp, DataValue.cpp, MetaInfo.cpp, IMTypes.h and Constants.h; installed FAIMSHelper.h equal to the pin) executed getCompensationVoltages on IM_FAIMS_test.mzML and on 16 synthetic experiments, and filterPeptidesByFAIMSCV under 10 parameter cases plus an empty annotation. The Rust voltages equal the C++ sets bit for bit, including the sign of zero, in iteration order, for every case without a FAIMS NaN; the Rust filter keeps exactly the C++ identifiers for the six accepted parameter cases. The three NaN cases, the four silent parameter cases and the empty annotation are refused natively, and their recorded C++ outcomes are asserted. The oracle stderr carries the missing-voltage warning three times (class_section_beyond_first_and_sentinel, only_sentinel, nan_first); Rust warns for the first two and refuses the third. Tier 3: the five FAIMSHelper_test.cpp sections are transcribed unchanged. Tier 4: CompensationVoltage ordering, equality and hashing, the refusals and the ceilings. filterPeptidesByFAIMSCV has no upstream class test; the oracle is its only executed evidence. No Debug-only precondition lies on this path.
